intro: Elder Torntusk is held at Jintha'alor in shackles. He says Hitah'ya the Keeper has the key to his bindings and is in the nearby cave, well guarded, and he asks you to kill her and bring it back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The key to my bindings is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper. She is in the nearby cave. Be careful, adventurer, for she is guarded well.
Kill her and bring the key back to loosen my shackles. Only then will I be free to return home.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Freedom at last! Thank you, friend. Revantusk will know your deeds!
